encryption.title: Backup encryption
encryption.intro: Whoever opens your backups, on Google Drive or in a file, cannot read them without the passphrase. This phone remembers it: only a restore asks for it.
encryption.warning: If you lose the passphrase, encrypted backups can no longer be opened. Nobody can recover it, not even us.

lock.forgotText: Without the PIN Soldo does not open. You can only erase the data on this phone and then restore it from a backup, on Google Drive or in a file.

lockSheet.title: PIN lock
lockSheet.intro: Hides Soldo from whoever picks up the phone: it asks for the PIN when it opens and when you come back to it. It does not encrypt the data: backups have their own encryption.
lockSheet.mismatch: The two PINs do not match. Try again.
